name: Jodhpur
tagline: The blue city under Mehrangarh Fort
summary: Jodhpur's old city is painted in shades of blue and crowded beneath the cliffs of Mehrangarh, one of India's most impressive forts. Spice markets ring the clock tower, and the edge of the Thar Desert begins just beyond town.
seasonNote: October to March is best; the Rajasthan International Folk Festival is at Mehrangarh in October. April to June passes 40°C.
arrival: Jodhpur airport is 20 minutes from the old city with flights from Delhi and Mumbai; trains from Jaipur take about 5 hours.
gettingAround: Walk the blue lanes; rickshaws for the fort and Umaid Bhawan.
cashTip: Carry cash for the lanes and markets; UPI is common.
foodTip: Mirchi vada and kachori from the clock tower stalls, makhaniya lassi, and laal maas.
buyTip: Spices and tea from Sardar Market, bandhani tie-dye, and jodhpurs from the tailors.
baseArea: Heritage guesthouses in the blue old city below the fort

items.name: Mehrangarh Fort
items.summary: A towering 15th-century fort on a cliff, with carved palaces, a superb museum and views over the blue city.
items.expect: Steep ramps; a lift is available; allow three hours.
items.tip: The audio guide is excellent; stay for sunset on the ramparts.
